findings.summary: The new rule that an opened invitation hides the sender until acceptance conflicts with screen.invitation, which shows an InvitePreview before the Accept/Decline decision; the spec never says what that preview may show if not the inviter.

Hiding the inviter until acceptance undermines the 'two explicit consents' model in policy.pairConsent, because the invitee would be accepting a pair with an unknown counterparty, so the consent is not informed.

The criterion now asserts inviter anonymity, but its sourceRefs (S.webapp.operations, S.webapp.concurrency) and operation.invite.accept contain no such requirement, so the new check traces to no requirement or operation effect.
